articles.title: Big Walk skipped Xbox to boycott Microsoft’s involvement with Israel
articles.description: Big Walk's co-op multiplayer walking adventure has proved popular since launching in August, but Xbox players have been excluded from the fun - and now the game's creators have explained why. Developer House House said in a blog post that it decided not to release Big Walk on Xbox consoles in accordance with the Palestinian-led […]
articles.author: Jess Weatherbed
